question: Does context prediction add to the level score, in the same 11-channel bank and the same top5-per-channel readout?
token_normalization: frozen cvf_v2.core.profiles rule per answer and channel: (x - median) / (IQR/1.349); scale<=1e-8 -> SD; SD<=1e-8 -> 1 (offline, whole answer; no causal-online claim)

predictor.inputs: z_token[t-1..t-16] (zeros where absent), 16 presence bits, t/max(T-1,1)
predictor.objective: sum of squared errors on the sampled tokens + 1.0 * ||W||_F^2, intercept unpenalized, closed form
predictor.fit_role: A = folds (k+3) mod 5 and (k+4) mod 5, per task
predictor.prediction_timing: before the current token enters the context

training_sample.scheme: hierarchical with replacement: cell -> source group -> answer -> token

residual_readout: e[t,c] = z_token[t,c] - prediction[t,c]; aux[s] = mean over channels of the per-channel top5 mean of e over the step's tokens (top5 per channel BEFORE the channel mean)
base: BASE from plan 5.2: PB q_loc = mean_c softmax_s(Z), PRMB q_step = mean_c sigmoid(Z), Z = per-answer per-channel standardization of the frozen top5 profile (S1 teacher, reproduces the Step 429 equal anchor)
correction: plan 5.4: score = BASE + 0.25 * sd_steps(BASE) * std_answer(aux); dose fixed, not tuned; dose 0 returns BASE byte-identically (tested)

arms.R_ZERO: prediction = 0 (residual = z_token itself), same top5 and correction: isolates readout/amplification from real prediction; its aux equals the channel mean of the frozen top5 profile (tested)
arms.R_NORESET: prediction[t,c] = sum_{u<t} z[u,c] / (t+1); answer-local, no external fit
arms.R_ONLY: aux of R_TEMP alone, no BASE (diagnostic)
arms.R_ABS: |e| instead of e, same correction (diagnostic; no post-hoc sign choice)

secondary: PB F1 with frozen CT7 gate
PRMScore (C-calibrated inner and q80; raw and per-answer z per the S0-C rule)
residual_diagnostics: per-channel MSE of ridge / zero / noreset predictions on H tokens, t<16 vs t>=16
per-channel corr(prediction, z) and corr(residual, z)
post-hoc: residual MSE after regressing each channel's residual on its current value (analysis only, never a scoring component)
interpretation: No success is attributed to temporal prediction unless R_TEMP - R_ZERO is supported; lower MSE alone is 'the self task was learned', not localization benefit.
